source: FBR Circular No. 02 of 2026-27 · Section 154B · Finance Act 2026
headline: YOUTUBE INCOME?
YOUR BANK NOW

blocks.text: YouTube or TikTok money isn't taxed in Pakistan.

items: Banks deduct **5%** when **social media platform revenue** reaches your account.
For residents it is a **minimum tax**. Declare it in your return.
Non-residents with no PE in Pakistan: it is a **final tax**.
